canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of ES:SENZ

parent.title: Weekend in Grassau anchored on dinner at ES:SENZ

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: ES:SENZ is inside Das Achental Resort, so the only true zero-walk option is to sleep on-site — alternatives in Mietenkam village put you 5–15 min on foot.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: Decision-grade guide to Chiemsee islands, Chiemgau peaks, castles, towns, spas and rainy-day picks inside a 30 km radius of Das Achental, with hours, prices and distances.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: The 30 km radius around ES:SENZ in Grassau covers Traunstein and Rosenheim — a small but active scene: Stellwerk18 startup center, TH Rosenheim Campus Chiemgau, ROSIK IT network, and one notable autumn event (PPC Camp at KuKo Rosenheim, Oct 29).

sources.title: Michelin Guide — ES:SENZ
sources.claim: ES:SENZ is located at Mietenkamer Straße 65, 83224 Grassau and holds three Michelin stars in the current Guide.

sources.title: Das Achental — ES:SENZ page
sources.claim: ES:SENZ is the in-house gourmet restaurant at Das Achental resort in Grassau, run by chef Edip Sigl.

sources.title: Traunsteiner Tagblatt — Three stars for Edip Sigl
sources.claim: In March 2024 Edip Sigl and the es:senz team were awarded three Michelin stars — the only three-star restaurant in Bavaria.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Grassau to Aschau
sources.claim: Road distance from Grassau to Aschau im Chiemgau is roughly 13.5 km / ~14 min by taxi.

sources.title: Residenz Heinz Winkler — official site
sources.claim: Boutique hotel in a late-medieval Aschau complex, former Hotel Post, 32 rooms.

sources.title: Abendzeitung — Residenz loses both stars after Winkler's death
sources.claim: After Heinz Winkler's October 2022 death, the Residenz lost both Michelin stars in 2023 and later regained one in 2024.

sources.title: Booking.com — Hotel Bonnschlössl
sources.claim: Hotel Bonnschlössl in Bernau am Chiemsee is a 15th-century castle (1477), ~7-min drive from Lake Chiemsee.

sources.title: Bonnschlössl — official apartments site
sources.claim: Bonnschlössl runs as ten luxury vacation apartments at Ferdinand-Bonn-Straße 2, 83233 Bernau am Chiemsee, with steam bath, Finnish sauna and park grounds.

sources.title: Farmhouse 1604 — official site
sources.claim: Listed stone fisherman's house in Seethal (Übersee), 1604 foundation stone, 4 apartments (95–230 m²), e-boat & outdoor sauna.

sources.title: Chiemgauhof Lakeside Retreat — official site
sources.claim: 28-suite lakeside hotel in Übersee, Matteo Thun minimalist design, LHW member.

sources.title: Rome2Rio — Übersee to Grassau
sources.claim: Übersee am Chiemsee sits ~4.8 km / 9 minutes taxi from Grassau.

sources.title: Inselhotel zur Linde — official Impressum
sources.claim: Inselhotel zur Linde on Fraueninsel has been welcoming guests for over 600 years, one of the oldest inns in Bavaria.

sources.title: Chiemsee Schifffahrt — Nachttaxi
sources.claim: Chiemsee Schifffahrt night taxi runs on demand between Gstadt and the islands until midnight; book +49 170 2053542 ~30 min before departure.

sources.title: Chiemsee-Chiemgau Tourist Board — Alte Zollstation
sources.claim: Landhotel Alte Zollstation in Pittenhart is a 14th-century former salt-route toll station, restored 2016, 25 rooms, 16th–17th-c. wooden ceiling and carved staircase preserved.

sources.title: Hotel-Gasthof Sperrer — official site
sources.claim: Multi-generation family-run traditional Bavarian inn with attached hotel rooms in Grassau village.

sources.title: Berghotel & Chalets Adersberg — official site
sources.claim: Berghotel sits at 815 m on the Adersberg above Grassau, renovated 2021, Adersberg 2, 83224 Grassau.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Das Achental Resort
sources.claim: Michelin describes Das Achental as 'a perfect representative of modern-rustic Bavarian hospitality' with alpine-chic rooms.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Berghotel Adersberg
sources.claim: TripAdvisor lists Berghotel Adersberg ~2.9 mi from Grassau centre with ES:SENZ among nearby restaurants.

sources.title: Alte Zollstation — official site
sources.claim: Landhotel Alte Zollstation, Trostberger Straße 1, 83132 Pittenhart, Landhotel and traditional inn (Traditionswirtshaus).
